title: Server sends a second KEXINIT within one key exchange
quote: Algorithm negotiation messages (20 to 29) (but further SSH_MSG_KEXINIT messages MUST NOT be sent); / When this message is received, a party MUST respond with its own SSH_MSG_KEXINIT message, except when the received SSH_MSG_KEXINIT already was a reply.
rationale: The server KEXINIT absorbed by reset() opens the initial exchange, so any output with KEXINIT before the server NEWKEYS is a violation (typically answering the client KEXINIT, which already was a reply). Likewise after the server has sent a re-exchange KEXINIT, another KEXINIT before its NEWKEYS. Assumes the server sends its KEXINIT unprompted, as the mapper spec expects.
